items.title: Token prices fell a fifth; has your scribe price moved?
items.body: The average price suppliers pay the two main labs fell 21 per cent in October. Scribe and triage vendors buy those tokens. NLW's advice to businesses applies to a practice or PCN: you probably have more leverage than you are using. At renewal, ask whether lower model costs are being passed on. Zitron would say the cuts show sellers under strain, which is a reason to keep contracts short.

items.title: Leverage depends on being able to leave
items.body: The buyers getting deals are those who can switch. In general practice that means data portability: can consultation notes, templates and audit logs be exported in a usable form, and does the tool sit on top of the clinical system or lock into it. Ask before signing, not at renewal.

items.title: Independent auditors chosen by the audited
items.body: OpenAI has let outside safety evaluators in, but chooses them and controls what they see; one evaluator said the access does not meet its own bar. The parallel in health is familiar. We would not accept a manufacturer selecting and briefing its own inspector. DTAC and clinical safety sign-off should rest on evidence a supplier cannot curate.
